title: relay check starts 238 git processes per run
what: Measure which reads `relay check` repeats (per file, per record, per sha) and read the same data with few git calls: one ls-tree or cat-file --batch for many objects, values computed once per run and passed down. Same for the hook that runs it (the check mark hook).
why: Measured 29 Oct by the gate-speed design: one `relay check` run makes 238 git calls; test_check_mark_hook (7 tests) started 2479 git in 167 s. The same code runs in the owner's sessions as a hook, so every call there pays it too. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: 29 Oct, master ee932b26: tracing one `relay check` run counts 238 git process starts.
pass_cases: One relay check run starts a small fixed number of git processes (target set by the measurement, independent of the number of records).
